source_snapshot.criteria: Both list forms and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 80.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool but invents a title sensor and truncates evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; GB undefined and AMBIENT/TEMP_MB filters conflict.

old_problem: GB is an undefined Project acronym, while IB selects AMBIENT and OOB selects TEMP_MB; neither filter is tied to GB and they ordinarily describe different physical locations. The source lacks a member/location map and criteria jump from 2 to 80.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict without guessing GB. ED-03 permits its exact hardware/zone definition and sensor population to remain Project Configuration. The AMBIENT/TEMP_MB commands are preserved as source defects and cannot grade GB unless the signed mapping proves an alias. Complete inventories and per-member Web evidence preserve coverage; ED-15 prevents invented limits.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2036, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2037 / Wistron-BMC-01056-V002 / b97dfe472511d214.
GB remains opaque: no acronym expansion, board, device or thermal zone is invented.
Complete IB/OOB inventories are retained; the approved GB ID/type/physical-location map selects every member independently and all Web rows remain required.
AMBIENT and TEMP_MB are not accepted as equivalent or as GB evidence without explicit Project alias proof.
Criteria 1, 2 and 80 are preserved without fabricating 3-79.
No ipmitool, sensor read, authentication, Web capture, thermal/BMC write, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Verify every Project-defined GB sensor member is bound to the correct physical board/device/zone and reports SPEC-consistent identity, value/state, units, thresholds and freshness across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web.
required_package: SUT/BMC/firmware identity and signed opaque GB hardware/zone definition
Complete GB record IDs/types/member population and physical-location/five-view crosswalk
Explicit alias proof if AMBIENT or TEMP_MB is claimed as a GB member, approved ipmitool and protected access
BMC/platform/thermal owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; preserve logs and capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` before any filter. Apply only the signed GB member/physical map, capture every corresponding Web row and compare type/value/state/units/threshold/freshness under passive context. Record AMBIENT/TEMP_MB as source defects and do not execute them as GB selectors absent approved alias proof. Do not invent GB, alter thermal policy/thresholds, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved GB member appears exactly once at the correct physical location with fresh SPEC-valid consistent fields in all supported views; unrelated AMBIENT/TEMP_MB records do not substitute and no alarm occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the signed GB definition/population/map and complete supported-view evidence meeting approved rules. FAIL on wrong location, missing/extra/duplicate/stale member, view mismatch, exceeded approved limit or unrelated-filter substitution. Missing definition/map/limits is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive reads only; no sensor/threshold/BMC/thermal-policy or airflow change.
Protect credentials and preserve complete raw inventories before member selection.
Stop on unknown identity, wrong mapping, missing/stale data, mismatch or alarm.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve first state and context.
expected_evidence: Exact source and AMBIENT/TEMP_MB conflict record
SUT/BMC plus signed opaque GB definition, population and physical/five-view map
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list outputs with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web evidence for every member
Per-member comparison and missing/extra/duplicate analysis with passive thermal context
test_case.recovery: On wrong target/map, access failure, missing/mismatched telemetry or alarm, stop passive collection and preserve state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not change thermal/BMC state, clear logs or retry; escalate exact GB member and physical location.

source_conflict.reason: An opaque Project namespace and signed member/location map resolve GB without guessing; unrelated asymmetric filters are explicitly preserved as defects and excluded absent alias proof.

blocked.reason: Passive method, evidence, safety and recovery are defined; GB identity/member map and limits are Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Opaque GB hardware/zone definition, complete member/location/five-view map, approved limits/freshness and any AMBIENT/TEMP_MB alias proof.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO OPAQUE PROJECT GB SENSOR MATRIX; NO IPMITOOL, SENSOR READ, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, THERMAL/BMC WRITE, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
